test_title: PYST 62: SSC CPO - General Intelligence and Reasoning (Held On 28 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option in which the numbers share the same relationship as that shared by the given pair of numbers.

23 − 27
solution:
**The logic followed here is: **(Reverse of 1st number - Sum of the digits of 1st number) = 2nd number

23 − 27

32 - __**(2 + 3)**__ = 27

__**32 - 5**__ = 27

27 = 27 (LHS = RHS) 

So, checking each option one by one:-

Option 1) 15 − 25

51 - __**(1 + 5)**__ = 25

__**51 - 6**__ = 25

45 ≠ 25 (LHS ≠ RHS)

Option 2) 11 − 33

11 - __(1 + 1)__ = 33

__11 - 2__ = 33

9 ≠ 33 (LHS ≠ RHS)

Option 3) 15 − 45

51 - __**(1 + 5)**__ = 45

__**51 - 6**__ = 45

**45 = 45 (LHS = RHS)**

Option 4) 11 − 55

11 - __(1 + 1)__ = 55

__11 - 2__ = 55

9 ≠ 55 (LHS ≠ RHS)

Thus, out of all the options '15 − 45' share the same relationship as that shared by the given pair of numbers.

Hence, **"Option 3"** is the correct answer.
